title: Dynamic Runtime Architecture Engine — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Restructures software components while an application runs, subject to compatibility and safety checks. A proposed engine that re-architects a running application: swapping components, re-routing data flows, and changing topology without stopping the system — but only after compatibility and safety checks pass. If a restructure fails its checks, the application continues on the old architecture untouched.
